question.text: Mischmetal is an alloy consisting mainly of :

solution.text: Misch metal consists of Lanthanide metal <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>95</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow></mfenced></math>and iron <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow></mfenced></math> and traces of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>Ca</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Al</mi></math>.
